<function name="GetMaxDamage" parent="CTakeDamageInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the maximum damage. See <page>CTakeDamageInfo:SetMaxDamage</page>.

This is only set by "multi damage" instances in the engine, and is only checked by the strider NPC when receiving explosive damage.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The maximum amount of damage in the "multi damage" instance.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
